question.html:
Which of the following correctly describes the central maximum in a single-slit diffraction pattern?

I. It is twice as wide as the secondary maxima.

II. It is the most intense fringe.

III. Its width decreases if the slit is made narrower.

  1. I and II only
  2. II and III only
  3. I and III only
  4. I, II and III
